description: A node and a warning over tokens out of text order have the tokens' source, from the least source start among them to the greatest source end (engine §1, §12). The second stage emits X[1,1) Y[0,0) Z[1,1) for `a` and X[2,2) Y[1,1) Z[2,2) for `b`, so X Y ends before it starts.

documents.p.md:
## Letters

```jbogenbau
%stage letters
```

- [a](a.md)
  ```jbogenbau
  %include "a.md"
  ```

## Pairs

```jbogenbau
%stage pairs
```

- [b](b.md)
  ```jbogenbau
  %include "b.md"
  ```

## Triples

```jbogenbau
%stage triples
```

- [c](c.md)
  ```jbogenbau
  %include "c.md"
  ```
documents.a.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text (letter letter)
%rule letter char %emits $ :: A, $ :: A
%rule char "a" | "b"
```
documents.b.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text (pair pair)
%rule pair (prefix edge)
%rule prefix A %emits ε :: X
%rule edge ($n:nothing A) %emits ε :: Y, $n :: Z
%rule nothing ε
```
documents.c.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text (triple triple)
%rule triple (xy Z)
%rule xy w! (X Y)
```
